content.name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
entries: If the stone is touching the ground, you can use an action to speak its command word and summon an {@creature earth elemental}, as if you had cast the {@spell conjure elemental} spell. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn. The stone weighs 5 pounds.

content.name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
entries: While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to summon an {@creature Earth Elemental|SRD52}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
